personality_one_liner: A sharp, tactical, high-performance command center built for aviation professionals, prioritizing instant clarity, training load visibility, and disciplined execution over decorative softness.

spacing.rule: Dense and intentional. Use spacing to group tactical data (reps, load, flights) tightly, with clear structural dividers between disparate sections.

do's: Use only for the bottom tab bar and sticky headers if absolute necessity arises
dont's: No glass on data cards, list rows, or workout execution panels. Solid surfaces prioritize readability.

screens.name: Client Home / Today's Workout
screens.purpose: A live operational surface showing today's flight duty status (if any), current training load (Green/Amber/Red), and the core workout action.

states.loading: Centered sleek spinner in brand color
states.empty: No workout scheduled today. Show airplane window view tinted dark with a 'Rest & Recover' message.
states.error: Error fetching today's plan. Retry button.

screens.layout: Header: Large Barlow Condensed date with a status indicator (Green/Amber/Red) denoting today's Training Load. Hero section: An image card (gym workout) overlaid with gradient scrim and the main CTA 'Start Today's Workout'. Below: Duty Roster snapshot (e.g., 'Flight LHR -> JFK'). Bottom: horizontally scrolling snapshot of the week's load. Use strict dividers, high contrast.

screens.name: Weekly Training Calendar
screens.purpose: Visualize the synergy between upcoming flight rosters and the AI-planned workouts, color-coded for fatigue.

states.empty: No roster uploaded. Show 'Upload Roster' CTA.
states.error: Failed to load calendar. Retry button.

screens.layout: Top: Month selector. Grid or Vertical list layout (Vertical preferred for mobile tracking). Each day row displays: Date, Roster icon (plane for flight day, house for off day), Training Load color bar (Green/Amber/Red on the left edge), and scheduled Workout title. Actionable rows lead to workout details.

screens.name: Roster Upload & Confirmation
screens.purpose: Allows clients to upload PDF/Image of roster and confirms the AI-extracted flight duties.

states.loading: Animated scanning overlay on the uploaded document
states.empty: Upload slot ready. Display an aviation-styled upload box.
states.error: AI failed to parse roster. Prompt manual entry or re-upload.

screens.layout: Upload Screen: Large dashed-border drop zone. Confirmation Screen: A structured list of extracted duties. 'Flight', 'Layover', 'Timezone Shift'. Use surfaceSecondary for list items with strict text alignment. Sticky primary CTA 'Confirm Roster' anchored at the bottom.

screens.name: Coach Dashboard (Client List)
screens.purpose: Command center for the coach to see which clients need plan approvals or have flagged red-load days.
screens.layout: Top: Segmented control (Needs Review / Active / Off-Track). List of dynamic client cards. Each card: Client Name, upcoming flight status, current week load (bar graph or colored pills), and a 'Review AI Plan' quick action. Use surfaceSecondary cards with 0 shadow and stark dividers.

screens.name: Nutrition Tracker
screens.purpose: Log meals via photos and view AI feedback on macro alignment.

states.empty: No meals logged. Show a faded meal prep background image with 'Log First Meal' CTA.

screens.layout: Top: Stacked macro progress bars (not soft rings, sharp linear progress bars). Middle: Meal list categorized by time. Each meal features a thumbnail (photo) and macro breakdown. Floating Action Button (FAB) or sticky bottom CTA to 'Add Meal / Snap Photo'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design specifically for the '7 Dark-First Utility' personality. Absolutely no soft rounded cards, no glassmorphism abuse, and no pastel shades.
The primary action color is Rust/Amber (#E85D04). Use it for primary CTAs and active states.

Crucial Feature: The Green/Amber/Red day scoring must use the exact status colors provided (success/warning/error). Display these as structural tags, vertical left-borders on list items, or solid pills.
All text on imagery MUST have a top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to #111827) overlay to ensure readability. See the <Imagery_and_Texture> rules.
Implement persistent sticky bottom CTAs wrapped in SafeArea for all form submissions (e.g. 'Confirm Roster', 'Approve Plan').
Use solid dividers (1px solid #1C1C22) instead of shadows to separate modules.
Both Client and Coach roles exist. Provide role-based tab navigation arrays.
Coach Dashboard client list should prioritize rapid scanning: align numerical and status data cleanly to the right edge of rows.
Haptics: Provide haptic feedback configuration mappings in your JSON for interactions like starting a workout, logging a meal, or approving a plan.
